title: Marshall Hall's theorem through finite cores
abstract: Formalizes Marshall Hall's finite-index free-factor theorem for finitely generated subgroups of finite-rank free groups. The proof extracts the finitely many suffix states of a subgroup generating set, completes the resulting partial generator actions to permutations of a finite state set, identifies the connected orbit with a finite core, and extends a geodesic spanning tree to obtain an inclusion-compatible free-product decomposition. The repository also proves binary and finite-indexed free-group instances of Grushko--Neumann rank additivity, the arbitrary-factor binary theorem, and the LERF consequence. The arbitrary-factor proof is carried by a finite labelled-graph fold, source-unfold, and monochromatic-vertex contraction reduction.
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
